platform: WRMC 91.1 FM Music Directors Process Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: WRMC’s official About page publicly lists Cate Richardson and Honor McFadden as Music Directors with crichardson@middlebury.edu and hmcfadden@middlebury.edu, but the reviewed official pages do not publish an unsolicited-music submission form or asset-delivery requirements. A human may send one coordinated, asset-free process inquiry to the Music Director function asking whether external and international artists are accepted and requesting the authorized format, link, metadata, release-window, clean-edit, explicit-content and AI-origin rules. Do not contact both directors separately, attach audio, provide private links, target individual DJs, infer a postal route or send a release until WRMC expressly confirms the procedure.
